facts.raw_span: a large unhealed ulcer measuring 20 × 14-cm²
had persisted for the past 3 years
a patch of healthy skin (7.5 × 4 cm²) on her left forearm
lacking blistering
compound heterozygous alterations (c.2992 + 2T>G and c.8621-30A>G) at splice sites in COL7A1
Dominant RNA transcripts with premature stop codons, wild-type reads rare (1.1%)
High rates of wild-type transcripts (35.0%)
Wild-type reads rare (1.9%)
Immunofluorescence and transmission electron microscopy of the grafted area showed type VII collagen and anchoring fibrils
Sanger sequencing showing compound heterozygous COL7A1 alteration
